observation_summary: The NumericEntityUnescaper throws a StringIndexOutOfBoundsException when processing entities that do not end with a semicolon, because it attempts to access characters beyond the end of the input string.
reasoning_summary: The code at line 54 uses a while loop `while(input.charAt(end) != ';')` to find the end of an entity. If the input string ends before a semicolon is found, `end` increments until it exceeds the string length, causing an IndexOutOfBoundsException. This is a classic missing boundary check (guard) for the end of the string within the loop condition.

alternative_types.why_not_primary: While the loop logic is flawed, the root cause is the missing boundary check (guard) to ensure 'end' does not exceed the string length before accessing 'charAt(end)'.
